A '''battle''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Refrax]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the battle, the Rebel forces managed to board and capture the Imperial [[Field Secured Container Vessel/Legends|Field Secured Container Vessel]] ''[[Black Ice/Legends|Black Ice]]''.<ref name="BI" />
